title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_en: Beating the grass to startle the snake
summary_zh: 本页展示了成语“打草惊蛇”的标题，配有一条被石头惊吓的蛇的插图，蛇的表情惊恐，尾巴被石头击中。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh: 春秋时期，秦穆公一直想找机会消灭郑国。有一天，他忽然收到了一封信，是驻守在郑国的将军写来的：主公，郑国的国君去世了，我们已经控制了郑国都城的北门。请主公速速发兵，一举消灭郑国。
page_text_en: In the Spring and Autumn period, King Mu of Qin had always been looking for an opportunity to destroy the state of Zheng. One day, he suddenly received a letter from a general stationed in Zheng: 'Your Majesty, the king of Zheng has passed away, and we have already taken control of the northern gate of the capital city. Please send troops immediately to destroy Zheng in one swift move.'
summary_zh: 本页讲述了春秋时期秦穆公收到驻守郑国将军的密信，称郑国国君已死且北门已被控制，请求秦穆公速发兵消灭郑国。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh:
这真是个千载难逢的好机会呀！
秦穆公立刻命孟明视为主将，西乞术、白乙丙为副将，挑选了精兵三千名，战车三百辆，准备偷袭郑国。
偷袭可是个大机密，一定不能让郑国的人知道！就连秦军中，也只有三位领兵的将军知道他们的目的地。
page_text_en:
This is truly a rare opportunity!
King Mu of Qin immediately appointed Meng Ming as the main general, Xi Qi Shu and Bai Yi Bing as deputy generals, selected 3,000 elite soldiers and 300 war chariots, and prepared to launch a surprise attack on the State of Zheng.
A surprise attack is a great secret; we must not let the people of Zheng know! Even within the Qin army, only the three commanding generals know their destination.
summary_zh: 秦穆公决定趁郑国国君去世之机，秘密派孟明视等三位将军率精兵三千、战车三百辆偷袭郑国，并严格保密，仅三位将领知晓目的地。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh:
秦国与郑国相距千里，中间隔着好几个诸侯国。士兵们都登上了战车，一路上马不停蹄。三个月后，他们才到达离郑国不远的滑国。
这晚，秦军驻扎在滑国都城外。主将孟明视心里很得意：“明天再行军一天，就能到郑国了。如果这次偷袭成功了，我的功劳是最大的。”
page_text_en:
The State of Qin was thousands of miles away from the State of Zheng, with several feudal states in between. The soldiers climbed onto their war chariots and traveled without stopping. After three months, they finally reached the state of Hua, not far from Zheng.
That night, the Qin army camped outside the capital of Hua. General Meng Ming Shi felt very pleased: "Just one more day of marching, and we'll reach Zheng. If this surprise attack succeeds, I will have the greatest merit."
summary_zh: 秦军长途跋涉三个月后抵达滑国，主将孟明视在营地中得意地盘算着明日即可抵达郑国，对偷袭成功充满信心。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh:
可是，有一个过路的人，看见滑国城外装备齐整的秦军，心里生了疑。这个人，就是郑国的商人弦高。弦高觉得很奇怪。最近没听说哪个国家要跟秦国开战呀，那秦军千里迢迢来到这里，是要打谁呢？过了滑国就是郑国，难道……
难道……
page_text_en:
However, a passerby, seeing the well-equipped Qin army outside the city of Hua, became suspicious. This man was Xiang Gao, a merchant from the State of Zheng. Xiang Gao found it very strange. He hadn't heard that any country was going to fight with Qin. Why had the Qin army traveled so far to this place? Who were they going to attack? After Hua was Zheng. Could it be...?
Could it be...?
summary_zh: 郑国商人弦高路过滑国，发现秦军驻扎，心生疑虑，推测秦军可能要攻打郑国。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh:
他们要攻打郑国！
他们要攻打郑国！
弦高吓了一跳，想起他从郑国
出来的时候，大街上人来人往，
吆喝声不断；对进城出城的人，
守城士兵检查得也不严。
郑国人还不知道，秦军就要打
过来啦！
page_text_en:
They are going to attack the State of Zheng!
They are going to attack the State of Zheng!
Xiangao jumped in fright, recalling that when he left Zheng, the streets were bustling with people, filled with shouts and calls; the guards at the city gates didn't check travelers in or out very strictly.
The people of Zheng don't even know yet — the Qin army is coming to attack!
summary_zh: 郑国商人弦高在滑国发现秦军驻扎，惊觉秦军可能攻打郑国，而郑国毫无防备，他意识到情况危急。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh:
弦高是做贩牛生意的。他急忙把牛赶到一家客栈，提笔匆匆写了一封信，派人连夜送回郑国。接着，他挑了十二头膘肥体壮的大黄牛，又选了四张熟牛皮……都准备好后，他就焦急地在房间里走来走去，一直熬到天亮。
从滑国到郑国，只需要一天的时间！必须赶快派人回郑国报信，还要想办法拖住秦军。
page_text_en:
Xiang Gao was in the cattle trading business. He hurriedly drove his cattle to an inn, quickly wrote a letter, and sent someone to deliver it to Zheng overnight. Then, he selected twelve plump, healthy yellow oxen and chose four pieces of tanned cowhide... After everything was ready, he paced anxiously in the room, staying awake until dawn.
It only takes one day to travel from Hua to Zheng! We must send someone back to Zheng immediately to deliver the news, and also find a way to delay the Qin army.
summary_zh: 郑国商人弦高发现秦军驻扎滑国后，立即写信报信，并准备了十二头牛和四张牛皮，打算用这些物资拖延秦军，为郑国争取时间。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh: "喔——喔——喔——"鸡叫三遍，天刚放亮，弦高就让随从赶着十二头牛，带着四张熟牛皮，来到了秦军的营地。营地里，秦军已经整装待发了。弦高急忙走上前，对一名卫兵说道："烦请通报主将，郑国使臣弦高求见!"
page_text_en: "Cock-a-doodle-doo—cock-a-doodle-doo—cock-a-doodle-doo!" After the rooster crowed three times and the sky just began to brighten, Xiang Gao sent his attendant to drive twelve oxen and carry four pieces of tanned cowhide to the Qin army's camp. In the camp, the Qin troops were already fully prepared. Xiang Gao hurried forward and said to a guard, "Please inform the commander that Xiang Gao, envoy of the State of Zheng, requests an audience!"
summary_zh: 郑国商人弦高在天刚亮时，带着十二头牛和四张牛皮来到秦军营地，向卫兵通报自己是郑国使臣，请求面见主将。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh: "谁，谁来求见？"孟明视已经跨上战马，听了卫兵的禀报，大吃一惊，差点从马背上摔下来。卫兵大声重复道："郑国使臣弦高，求见将军。"这回孟明视听清楚了，立即下令把弦高带过来。不一会儿，一个胖乎乎的郑国人被带到了孟明视的马前。
page_text_en: "Who, who is here to see me?" Meng Mingshi had already mounted his warhorse. Upon hearing the soldier's report, he was greatly startled and nearly fell off his horse. The soldier shouted again: "Envoy Xiangao of the State of Zheng, requesting to see the general." This time, Meng Mingshi heard clearly and immediately ordered Xiangao to be brought forward. In no time, a plump man from Zheng was brought before Meng Mingshi's horse.
summary_zh: 秦军主将孟明视在营地中接到卫兵禀报，称郑国使臣弦高求见，他大吃一惊，随即下令将弦高带至马前。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh: 孟明视骑在马上问："来者何人？""禀将军，在下弦高，郑国使臣。"弦高躬身行礼道。"哦，是郑国国君派你来的？有什么事？"孟明视紧盯着弦高，紧握着手中的剑。
page_text_en: Meng Mingshi, riding on horseback, asked: "Who are you?" "Reporting to the general, I am Xiang Gao, an envoy from the State of Zheng," Xiang Gao bowed respectfully. "Oh, sent by the ruler of Zheng? What is your business?" Meng Mingshi stared intently at Xiang Gao, gripping his sword tightly.
summary_zh: 秦军主将孟明视在营地中接见自称郑国使臣的弦高，对其身份和来意产生怀疑，神情警惕。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh:
弦高的心扑通扑通直跳，指着他赶来的那群牛说："我国国君听说将军要出征，特意让我准备了四张熟牛皮和十二头肥牛，在此恭候犒赏贵军。"说完，他就双手奉上了礼单。
孟明视接过礼单，心里又惊又怕："我们偷袭郑国，本想出其不意，攻其不备。如今大军才入滑国，郑国就派了使者来送礼……看来，我们的偷袭行动已经暴露了！"
看来我们暴露了！
page_text_en:
Xiang Gao's heart pounded as he pointed to the herd of cattle he had brought, saying, "Our king heard that your general is about to set out on campaign, so he specially instructed me to prepare four hides of cured cowhide and twelve fat oxen, to welcome and honor your troops." After speaking, he respectfully presented the gift.
Meng Mingshi received the gift, his heart filled with shock and fear: "We were planning to sneak an attack on Zheng, hoping to catch them off guard. But now, just after our army entered Hua State, Zheng has already sent an envoy with gifts... It seems our surprise attack has been exposed!"
It seems we've been exposed!
summary_zh: 郑国商人弦高向秦军主将孟明视献上牛皮和肥牛作为犒赏，声称是郑国国君所派；孟明视接礼后惊觉郑国已知晓其偷袭计划，认为行动暴露。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh: 孟明视让士兵把礼物收了下来，对弦高说：‘听说贵国上一任国君去世了，所以我国国君派我们来保护贵国。’弦高镇定地回答道：‘为了国家的安全，我们郑国的士兵天天操练，日夜守卫，不怕有敌人前来进攻，请将军放心吧！’‘既然如此，那我们就不用去郑国了。你也回去吧！’孟明视放弦高走出了兵营。
page_text_en: Meng Mingshi had his soldiers receive the gifts and said to Xiang Gao: 'I heard that your previous king has passed away, so our king sent us to protect your country.' Xiang Gao calmly replied: 'For the safety of our country, our soldiers in Zheng train every day and guard day and night. We are not afraid of enemies attacking. Please rest assured, General!' 'If that is the case, then we will not go to Zheng after all. You may return now!' Meng Mingshi let Xiang Gao leave the camp.
summary_zh: 孟明视收到弦高献上的礼物后，假称是来保护郑国，弦高则镇定回应郑国已有防备，孟明视因此判断郑国已知晓其偷袭计划，决定放弃进攻并放弦高离开。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh: 千里迢迢赶来，偷袭郑国不成，那就顺手进攻滑国吧！这天晚上，滑国国君正在做美梦呢，就被秦军袭击了。秦军回国途中，路过晋国的崤山。这时，两位副将都担心地说：‘我们灭了中原的滑国，激怒了中原霸主晋国。现在过崤山，晋国会不会设下埋伏呢？’
page_text_en: They had traveled a long way to sneak an attack on Zheng, but failed. So they decided to attack Hua instead! That night, the king of Hua was dreaming sweetly when he was suddenly attacked by the Qin army. On their way back, the Qin army passed through Xiaoshan in the state of Jin. At this moment, two deputy generals worriedly said: 'We have destroyed Hua in the Central Plains, angering Jin, the dominant power. Now that we are passing through Xiaoshan, will Jin set an ambush for us?'
summary_zh: 秦军因偷袭郑国失败，转而进攻滑国并将其攻破。在回国途中经过晋国的崤山时，两位副将担忧晋国会设伏，因而心生疑虑。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh: "不必多虑！"孟明视哈哈大笑，"我们秦军兵强马壮，晋国哪敢偷袭？就算是遇到守山的晋军，他们也不是我们的对手！"第二天，秦军走进了崤山的密林深处，果然遇到了晋军。秦军先锋挥刀迎敌，晋军抵挡不住，顺着山路逃跑了。
page_text_en: "No need to worry!" Meng Mingshi laughed heartily, "Our Qin army is strong and powerful. How dare the State of Jin launch a surprise attack? Even if we encounter Jin troops guarding the mountain, they are no match for us!" The next day, the Qin army entered the dense forest of Xiaoshan, and indeed encountered the Jin army. The Qin vanguard swung their swords to engage, and the Jin troops, unable to hold their ground, fled along the mountain path.
summary_zh: 秦军主将孟明视自信满满，认为晋国不敢偷袭，次日秦军进入崤山密林时果然遭遇晋军，但晋军抵挡不住，仓皇逃走。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh: 秦军紧追不舍，进入了一个山谷。忽然，山谷里金鼓齐鸣，喊杀声震天，成千上万的晋军从树林里冒了出来，直向秦军扑去。秦军被这突然的袭击吓蒙了，顿时乱作一团，抱头逃窜。这一战，秦军全军覆没，就连傲慢轻敌的孟明视也成了晋军的俘虏。
page_text_en: The Qin army pressed on relentlessly, entering a valley. Suddenly, the valley echoed with the beating of drums and the roar of battle cries, as tens of thousands of Jin soldiers emerged from the woods, charging straight at the Qin forces. The Qin army, stunned by the sudden attack, immediately fell into chaos and fled in panic. In this battle, the entire Qin army was annihilated, and even the arrogant and overconfident Meng Mingshi became a prisoner of the Jin army.
summary_zh: 秦军进入山谷后遭遇晋军伏击，全军覆没，主将孟明视被俘。

title_en: Startling the Snake by Beating the Grass
page_text_ocr_zh:
秦军的行动，就像用棍子打草，郑国和晋国就像草里的蛇，被惊动了，咬伤了秦军。秦军是不小心打草惊蛇，吃了败仗。而有时候，我们会故意“打草”，让隐藏的敌人暴露出来。这样的计策，也叫“打草惊蛇”。

为什么被打的总是我？

秦军想去偷袭，却不注意隐藏行踪，被郑国商人弦高发现了；攻打滑国，又惊动了晋国。最终，晋国在崤山设下埋伏，歼灭了秦军。
page_text_en:
The Qin army's actions were like using a stick to beat the grass. Zheng and Jin were like snakes hidden in the grass, startled and biting back at the Qin. The Qin accidentally 'startled the snake by beating the grass' and suffered defeat. Sometimes, however, we deliberately 'beat the grass' to expose hidden enemies. This strategy is called 'startling the snake by beating the grass'.

Why is it always me who gets hit?

The Qin army wanted to launch a surprise attack, but failed to conceal their movements. They were discovered by the Zheng merchant Xiang Gao; then, while attacking Hua, they alarmed the Jin state. In the end, Jin set an ambush at Xiaoshan and annihilated the Qin army.
summary_zh: 本页通过比喻解释了‘打草惊蛇’的典故，回顾了秦军因行踪暴露被郑国商人弦高发现，进而攻打滑国惊动晋国，最终在崤山被晋军伏击全军覆没的经过。
